column1: Summary
column7: Description

column1: Enforce MFA for all staff Microsoft 365 accounts
column7: As the security team, we need MFA on every staff account so a stolen password alone cannot access patient email. Acceptance: 100% of active users enrolled; legacy auth blocked.

column1: Remove 6 stale accounts of former employees
column7: Quarterly access review found 6 enabled accounts for staff who left. Disable, then delete after 30 days per retention policy.

column1: Create least-privilege role for front-desk staff
column7: Front desk only needs scheduling and check-in. Remove access to billing exports. Document the role in Confluence.

column1: Rotate shared Wi-Fi admin password
column7: Router admin password has not changed since install. Rotate, store in password manager, restrict admin UI to wired VLAN.

column1: Quarterly user access review
column7: Export user list, have each manager confirm access, record sign-off in Confluence.

column1: Patch 14 laptops missing critical Windows updates
column7: Vulnerability scan shows 14 endpoints missing the latest critical cumulative update. Push via MDM, confirm with rescan.

column1: Enable full-disk encryption on remaining 3 laptops
column7: BitLocker/FileVault off on 3 devices that store PHI. Enable and escrow recovery keys.

column1: Replace end-of-life VPN client
column7: Current VPN client is past vendor support. Pilot new client with 5 users, then roll out to all remote staff.

column1: Block USB mass storage on front-desk PCs
column7: Prevent PHI copied to USB drives. Apply policy via MDM, allow exceptions by ticket only.

column1: Standardize endpoint antivirus alerts to one console
column7: Two AV products are in use. Consolidate to one and forward alerts to the SIEM.

column1: Chat-api service account can read secrets cluster-wide
column7: Finding from K8s AI Security Lab Day 3: token auto-mounted and bound to ClusterRole with secrets read. Fix: automountServiceAccountToken false + namespaced Role.

column1: Containers run as root with privilege escalation
column7: Lab finding. Fix: runAsNonRoot, allowPrivilegeEscalation false, drop ALL capabilities, PSA restricted.

column1: No NetworkPolicies - lateral movement possible
column7: Lab finding. Fix: default-deny plus allow chat-api to Ollama on model port and DNS.

column1: API key stored in plain environment variable
column7: Lab finding. Move FAKE-API-KEY into a Kubernetes Secret; plan Sealed Secrets for v2.

column1: Add Trivy image + config scan to CI, fail on CRITICAL
column7: GitHub Actions workflow runs trivy image and trivy config on every push and uploads reports.

column1: Forward firewall logs to SIEM
column7: Send firewall syslog to the SIEM and confirm events arrive within 5 minutes.

column1: Detection: 10+ failed logins in 5 minutes
column7: Write and test an alert rule for brute-force attempts against M365 and VPN.

column1: Detection: login from new country
column7: Alert when a user signs in from a country never seen for that user in 90 days.

column1: Tune noisy antivirus alert for scanner software
column7: Document scanner triggers ~40 false positives per day. Add a scoped exclusion and document why.

column1: Run phishing simulation for all staff
column7: Send one simulated phishing email, track click rate, assign training to clickers.

column1: Write VPN troubleshooting runbook
column7: Confluence runbook covering the 5 most common VPN tickets. Link it as a JSM knowledge base article.

column1: Write incident response plan v1
column7: One-page IR plan: roles, severity levels, contact tree, breach notification timeline.

column1: Postmortem: service account token theft (lab)
column7: Blameless postmortem for the K8s lab attack chain: timeline, root cause, fixes, follow-ups.

column1: Document backup and restore test
column7: Restore one server from backup, record time to restore and any gaps.
